| I want to… | Start here |
| --- | --- |
| Automate a task with an installed connector | [Write a workflow](/workflows/writing-workflows/) and [test it with a scenario](/testing/scenarios/). |
| Build pages for staff or visitors | [Create a site](/sites/overview/) and [call a workflow from a page](/sites/calling/). |
| Integrate a vendor with Sanoma | [Build a connector](/building-connectors/define-a-connector/) and [test its driver and fake](/testing/conformance/). |
| Package workflows and sites for another company to use | [Organize them in an app](/start/apps/). |
| Give an agent access to the company | [Connect an agent over MCP](/start/agents-over-mcp/). |

To see which operations an existing vendor already provides, look it up in the [connector reference](/reference/connectors/).
